newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA CRISIL ASSIGNS AA RATING TO HUDCO.
newsitem.headline: INDIA CRISIL ASSIGNS AA RATING TO HUDCO.

text.p: The Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) said it had assigned an "AA" rating to the 5,000-million-rupee bonds issue by the Housing & Urban Development Corporation Limited (HUDCO).
This rating indicates high safety with regard to timely payment of interest and principal, CRISIL said in astatement on Wednesday.
HUDCO, a notified public financial institution, was set up in 1970 as a Government of India Enterprise with a mandate to undertake housing and urban development and related programmes, CRISIL said.
A wholly-owned Government of India Enterprise, HUDCO is one of the government's key operating arms in providing shelter to economically weaker sections of society.

The Central Government has agreed to put in four billion rupees in equity in the 9th Plan (1997-2001). With a significant shortfall in housing expected in future, HUDCO has an important role to play in the Indian government's public policy.

Provisional estimates for 1996/97 show that HUDCO had a net margin of about 14 percent and a gearing of 6.7 times as at March 31, 1997 giving it the flexibility to take on additional debt, CRISIL said.
However, HUDCO's ability to maintain its asset quality and continuously raise funds at economical rates would be critical for its future performance, it added.
